items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: Well, we call him Papa Teal here. That was Lorenzo Teal's father. He played clarinet in the band.

ctx.x: Did he play something like the clarinet or a violin player?

Oh, no. He played fiddle parts on the piccolo. And he was a very fine piccolo player, because I can tell from some people that I met in the Georgia Ministrel Brass Band. He was once a member of that. Well, we call him Papa Teal here. That was Lorenzo Teal's father. He played clarinet in the band. And also, old man, Piku. He was a clarinet player in the Georgia Ministrel Band. That's way before my time, but I can remember fellas that just tell me, like, Fred Simpson, he was the leader of the band of New York. And…
